scoring.rule: Phrase match, same rule for both arms. A path assertion hits when the record path appears anywhere in the output. An action assertion hits when at least one any_of phrase appears in the output (case-insensitive), anywhere. A stale_premise assertion hits when the record path appears under the Possibly stale heading and not under Do first, Avoid or Check before done; it is scored on the with-skill arm only, because the baseline has no such sections (N/A).
scoring.limit: A strict phrase match can miss a correct rewrite and can hit on an incidental phrase. Prompts and phrases are written by the same author as the skill, so rates can be biased upward.
